credit_line: Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art, Bentonville, Arkansas, 2010.97
description: A large, veined brown leaf arches across the composition. Below it sits a feather lined with brown and tan streaks. The tip of the feather is bright white. The objects sit on an arching, red shape that contrasts with the plain black background. At the top of the canvas, two semicircles of red peek into the composition.
